transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been really struggling with eating unusually large amounts of food lately. When it happens, I feel like I completely lose control over my eating and just can't stop.
After these episodes, do you ever try to make up for it by vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things at all. I have never tried to vomit, use laxatives, fast, or over-exercise to make up for what I ate.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa], but the patient explicitly denies any compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercise. That makes Bulimia Nervosa unlikely, leaving Binge-Eating Disorder as the current candidate.
